xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4437: Session Vault: dashboard "Continue here" (adopt, managed conversation, clone-and-register, WIP apply)

plan.title: Session Vault: dashboard "Continue here" (adopt, managed conversation, clone-and-register, WIP apply)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A browse copy of a conversation owned by another machine (PAN-4436) is read-only; continuing it requires `pan vault resume` in a terminal. No route creates a managed conversation resuming an outside session, the CLI's resume flow is interactive and not callable from a route, codex managed conversations read a private Codex home, and isWipPresent writes git objects so a preview cannot use it.
narratives.Proposal: A write-free GET continue-preview and a POST continue route pair backed by a dashboard service (src/dashboard/server/services/vault-continue.ts) that resolves the target checkout (saved cwd → gitOrigin-matched project → clone offer), applies the WIP snapshot (in place when clean, in a scratch workspace when dirty), rechecks drift, adopts the record inside the vault queue with an owner-token race guard, creates a managed conversation through a new conversations door that reuses the plain-fork spawn, and removes the browse row. A frontend dialog on the browse copy's read-only notice drives it, and the clone offer opens the existing Add-project dialog prefilled. Engine helpers: continue-inspect.ts; projects helper: origin-match.ts.
narratives.NonGoals:
- "Continued on <machine>" and "Local turns saved as a fork" states (moved to PAN-4447)
- @version forks from the dashboard, and harnesses other than claude-code and codex (400 with the CLI hint)
- A browser-chosen cwd or worktree directory
- Refactoring resumeCommand beyond moving driftNote
- Any edit to ConversationPanel.tsx, conversations.ts, conversation-runtime.ts, conversation-forks.ts or routes/conversations.ts (size caps)
- Cleaning up the abandoned scratch/vault-<id8> branch or workspace
- A new project-registration route or a second clone path
- Continuing a conversation this machine already owns
- Writing to the operator's real ~/.claude or ~/.codex in any test

autoDecisions.summary: Split the round-trip states ('Continued on <machine>', 'Local turns saved as a fork') and issue AC-4 into sibling PAN-4447, blocked by PAN-4436.
autoDecisions.rationale: With them the plan needed ~35 files; finalize allows 25. They do not depend on the Continue button (CLI resume produces them), so they ship independently. Issue body and a comment record the move; the design is carried in the PRD's Sibling S3 section.

autoDecisions.summary: Target checkout order: saved cwd if it exists here, else the project matched by gitOrigin slug, else a clone offer, else refuse with the `pan vault resume --cwd` hint. The route never accepts a browser-chosen cwd.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors the CLI's resolveTargetCwd plus the issue's match rule; a browser-supplied path is an injection surface the CLI already covers.

autoDecisions.summary: Dirty checkout: create a scratch isolated workspace 'vault-<id8>' through resolveWorkspaceCreateIntent/performWorkspaceCreate and apply the snapshot there; a dirty unregistered checkout is refused with 409 dirty-unregistered.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires the normal workspace path and never the dirty index; that path needs a registered project.

autoDecisions.summary: Clean checkout, including a primary checkout, applies the snapshot in place; the preview shows the resulting branch and base.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's AC requires in-place apply on clean, and a fresh clone depends on it; wip-apply never moves a branch backward.

autoDecisions.summary: The preview returns an opaque ownerToken (sha256 of owner environmentId, 16 hex); continue refuses with 'Already continued on <label>' when the owner changed since the preview; truly concurrent adopters are decided by adoptRecord's casRef.
autoDecisions.rationale: Adopting whatever the current owner is would silently steal a conversation another machine just continued; the token keeps environment ids out of the browser.

autoDecisions.summary: Codex records adopt into codexAgentHome(agents/<tmuxSession>) and record the thread id with recordCodexRolloutSession, with a checkpoint that resolveCodexRolloutPath finds the rollout.
autoDecisions.rationale: Managed codex conversations resume from their private home, not ~/.codex; a mismatch must fail loudly rather than add a second codex path.

autoDecisions.summary: The drift note is delivered with injectForkSummary after spawn; driftNote moves from resume.ts to the engine module and is re-exported for the CLI.
autoDecisions.rationale: injectForkSummary already waits for readiness and confirms acceptance for both harnesses; the dashboard must not import CLI modules.

autoDecisions.summary: Clone-and-register reuses the Add-project dialog via a prefilled initialUrl and an extra onCreated callback in its store.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue forbids a second registration path; the existing dialog already drives POST /api/projects and its job polling.

autoDecisions.summary: The conversation row uses forkStatus 'spawning' with no forkRequest; a dashboard restart mid-spawn ends it as failed but resumable.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses the plain-fork pattern without inventing a new persisted request shape; the native file exists so nothing is lost.

autoDecisions.summary: Model = record.model when it matches MODEL_ID_PATTERN, else omitted; effort unset.
autoDecisions.rationale: No hardcoded model fallback and effort defaults to high per repo rules.

items.title: Engine: write-free continue inspection and moved driftNote

expected_outputs: continue-inspect.test.ts, import-graph.test.ts and every tests/unit/cli/vault test pass

narrative.Action: PRD .pan/drafts/pan-4437.md WI-1. Create src/lib/vault/continue-inspect.ts exporting inspectContinue(record, targetCwd), driftFields(record, current, codePlaced) and the moved driftNote (from src/cli/commands/vault/resume.ts line 64, text unchanged). In resume.ts replace the function with `export { driftNote } from '../../../lib/vault/continue-inspect.js'` and import it for line 204. Placement: none when the wip is not captured or readCwdState is null; new-workspace when dirty; else in-place. Drift is [] when code is placed. Never call isWipPresent/buildWipCommit or any writing git command (they write objects). Import only node built-ins and sibling vault modules.

items.title: Given a clean temp git repo and a record with a captured WIP entry, when inspectContinue runs, then it returns codePlacement 'in-place' and drift []
Given a dirty temp git repo, when inspectContinue runs, then it returns codePlacement 'new-workspace' and `git count-objects -v` output is unchanged before and after
Given a non-git directory or a skipped WIP entry, when inspectContinue runs, then it returns codePlacement 'none' and a skipped entry carries the CLI reason text
Given driftNote(['branch']), when called from the new module, then it returns the exact sentence resume.ts produced, and tests/unit/cli/vault resume tests pass without edits
Projects: findProjectForGitOrigin matches a record origin to a registered project

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Pure function findProjectForGitOrigin(gitOrigin, projects) over listProjectsAsync() output: parseRepoUrl(gitOrigin).slug (src/lib/projects/repo-url.ts line 150) compared case-insensitively to config.github_repo when provider is 'github' and to config.gitlab_repo when 'gitlab'. First match in input order wins; null/unparseable/unknown-host origins return null.

items.title: Given github_repo 'acme/widget', when the origin is git@github.com:Acme/Widget.git or https://github.com/acme/widget, then the function returns that project
Given a GitLab origin, when only a project with a matching github_repo exists, then the function returns null, and it returns the project whose gitlab_repo matches
Given two matching projects, when the function runs, then it returns the first in input order; given a null or unparseable origin it returns null
Conversations: create and launch a managed conversation resuming an adopted session

expected_outputs: typecheck and lint complete without errors (including lint:circular)

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. New door src/lib/overdeck/conversation-vault-continue.ts: allocateVaultContinueNames() (<yyyymmdd>-<4 hex>, conv-<name>, the plain-fork rule at conversation-forks.ts lines 846-849); createVaultContinuedConversation(input) calls createConversation with claudeSessionId=newSessionId, cwd, harness, title, titleSource 'manual', titleSeed 'Continued from Session Vault', model only when MODEL_ID_PATTERN (src/lib/model-validation.ts) matches, projectKey, forkStatus 'spawning', no effort, no parentName, then markConversationActive; launchVaultContinuedConversation(conv, note) wraps the plain-fork tail in registerInFlightForkPipeline: ensureForkSessionReady(conv, conv.claudeSessionId, true, true), injectForkSummary(conv, note, 'vault-continue') only when note is non-null ('stranded' throws), markConversationActive, updateForkStatus(name, null); any throw → handleForkPipelineFailure. Do NOT edit conversations.ts, conversation-forks.ts or conversation-runtime.ts (size caps).

items.title: Given an input with an unsafe model string, when createVaultContinuedConversation runs, then createConversation receives claudeSessionId, cwd, harness, forkStatus 'spawning', no effort and no model
Given a created conversation and note null, when launchVaultContinuedConversation runs, then ensureForkSessionReady is called with (conv, id, true, true) and injectForkSummary is never called
Given a note, when the launch runs, then injectForkSummary is called once with caller 'vault-continue'; given a throwing spawn, then handleForkPipelineFailure receives the conversation name
Dashboard service: previewContinue and continueHere (target, WIP, drift, adopt, row, browse-row removal)

expected_outputs: typecheck and lint complete without errors
metadata.parallelSafeReason: It writes only its own two new files; its inputs (continue-inspect, origin-match, the conversation door) arrive through blocks edges, so once they land nothing else touches these files.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 (read D-2, D-4..D-9, D-12 first). previewContinue(vaultId) is write-free: open vault (not open → 409 vault-unavailable), read record (missing/tombstone → 404), resolve target by D-2 (saved cwd dir → project match → clone offer → no-checkout), inspectContinue, return the wire-contract ContinuePreview including ownerToken = sha256(owner.environmentId).slice(0,16). continueHere(vaultId, {expectedOwnerToken, onDrift}) runs everything inside one enqueueVaultOperation('continue', …): re-read; FR-13 harness check; owned-here and owner-token checks (D-6); target; WIP step (D-4: clean → applyWipSnapshot in place; dirty → isWipPresent or scratch workspace 'vault-<id8>' via resolveWorkspaceCreateIntent+performWorkspaceCreate then applyWipSnapshot there; dirty+no project → 409 dirty-unregistered); drift recheck (D-5); allocate names; adoptRecord with projectsRoot claudeProjectsRoot() (claude) or codexHome codexAgentHome(agents/<tmuxSession>) (codex, D-9); CAS conflict → 409 already-continued; path assertions (D-7 sessionFilePath, D-9 resolveCodexRolloutPath) → 500 on mismatch; codex recordCodexRolloutSession; createVaultContinuedConversation; void launchVaultContinuedConversation; removeVaultBrowseRow best-effort. All deps injectable. CHECKPOINT: openVaultContext and enqueueVaultOperation (PAN-4307) and removeVaultBrowseRow (PAN-4436) must exist on main; if missing or renamed, stop and `pan tell flywheel-orchestrator`.

items.title: Given a clean target and a captured WIP, when continueHere runs, then applyWipSnapshot, adoptRecord, createVaultContinuedConversation and removeVaultBrowseRow are called in that order inside one enqueueVaultOperation labelled 'continue'

Given a dirty target of a registered project, when continueHere runs, then a scratch workspace named vault-<id8> is created (vault-<id8>-2 after a path-exists finding) and the snapshot applies in its path; given a dirty unregistered target, then it returns 409 dirty-unregistered and adoptRecord is not called

Given adoptRecord returns a CAS conflict or the owner token no longer matches, when continueHere runs, then it returns 409 already-continued with the current owner label and creates no conversation row

Given a codex record, when continueHere runs, then adoptRecord receives a codexHome under agents/<tmuxSession>/ and recordCodexRolloutSession is called; given a materialized path that differs from sessionFilePath, then it returns 500 and creates no row
Given no target and a GitHub origin, when previewContinue runs, then it returns clone.slug and noTargetReason 'clone-offered', and no write dependency is called
Routes: GET continue-preview and POST continue with no-loss rows

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. In PAN-4307's src/dashboard/server/routes/vault.ts add GET /api/vault/records/:vaultId/continue-preview (rejectUnauthorizedDashboardRequest) and POST /api/vault/records/:vaultId/continue (rejectUnsafeDashboardMutationRequest), both calling only previewContinue/continueHere and returning {status, body}. Validate vaultId [0-9a-f-]+, expectedOwnerToken 16 hex chars, onDrift absent|'continue'|'note' (400 otherwise). Add two NO_LOSS_MATRIX rows beside the PAN-4307 vault rows (text in the PRD). No server.ts edit: PAN-4307 registers the layer.

items.title: Given a mocked previewContinue, when GET continue-preview is called, then the route returns its status and body unchanged
Given onDrift 'maybe' or no expectedOwnerToken, when POST continue is called, then it returns 400 and continueHere is not called; a POST without the CSRF header is refused
Given the two new routes, when tests/unit/lib/overdeck/no-loss-matrix.test.ts runs, then it passes with one row per route
Add-project dialog: open in clone mode with a prefilled URL and an extra onCreated

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6. useAddProjectDialog.show(mode?, returnTo?, options?: { initialUrl?, onCreated? }) stores initialUrl and onCreatedExtra; hide() clears them. AddProjectDialogHost passes initialUrl to AddProjectDialog and calls onCreatedExtra after its own onCreated, before hide(). AddProjectDialog passes initialUrl to AddProjectFormStep for the clone step only; the form step passes it to useProjectCreateIntent({ initialMode, onCreated, initialUrl }), which initializes url state with it. No new route: creation still goes through POST /api/projects.

items.title: Given show('clone', undefined, { initialUrl: 'https://github.com/acme/widget.git' }), when the host renders, then the clone form's URL field holds that URL
Given a successful create after that show, when the dialog completes, then the extra onCreated callback fires exactly once
Given hide() after a prefilled show, when show('clone') is called again, then the URL field renders empty
Frontend: Continue here button on the browse copy and the continue dialog

expected_outputs: typecheck and lint complete without errors

narrative.Action: PRD WI-7. Find PAN-4436's read-only notice (grep -rn "pan vault resume" src/dashboard/frontend/src; PRD name VaultReadOnlyNotice rendered by ComposerFooter.tsx) and add a 'Continue here' button opening the new VaultContinueDialog (vaultId derived from the row name vault-<vaultId>). The dialog fetches GET continue-preview (react-query key ['vault-continue-preview', vaultId]), renders the non-resumable, clone-offered (button calls useAddProjectDialog.getState().show('clone', undefined, { initialUrl: clone.url, onCreated: refetch })), no-checkout, clean and drift states with the exact texts in the PRD, and POSTs { expectedOwnerToken: preview.ownerToken, onDrift? } with dashboardMutationJsonHeaders() after ensureDashboardSession(). 200 → invalidate conversation queries, select the new conversation (same callback the fork flow uses via useConversationMutations' onSelectConversation), close. 409 already-continued → 'Already continued on <label>.'; 409 drift → drift step with returned fields. Do NOT edit ConversationPanel.tsx (at cap). Follow /pan-style-guide.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-8. Add optional env to IsolatedDashboardOptions (merged last into the spawned env). Build two OVERDECK_HOMEs (labels machine-a/machine-b via environment-id.json), one dir: vault, a temp HOME UH, a bare repo R and clone C; save a transcript with a forced WIP from HA (pan vault save captures force-mode WIP), join HB with --phrase-file, sync, register C in HB. Start the isolated dashboard for HB with env { HOME: UH, PATH: <stubdir>:$PATH } where <stubdir>/claude records argv and sleeps. Click Continue here; assert browse row gone, a row with the materialized claudeSessionId, the .jsonl under UH/.claude/projects, C holds the snapshot changes, argv.log contains --resume <uuid> (fallback if no terminal backend: skip only the argv assertion and say so in the PR body). Race: third home HC adopts T2 via `pan vault resume --no-launch --no-code` with HOME=UH2 while HB's dialog is open → 'Already continued on machine-c.'. Clone offer: record with an unregistered GitHub origin and missing cwd opens Add-project with the URL (do not submit). Never write the operator's real ~/.claude. Own browser context per test; cleanup in afterEach.
